# DiggityBets & HuntHub — Live Kick Casino Stream Engagement Suite

> Official community engagement platform, free-to-play spectator games, Provably Fair mini-games, and real-time OBS Studio overlays for [kick.com/diggitybets](https://kick.com/diggitybets) (`https://diggitybets.vip`).
> 100% free spectator participation (+18 Responsible Gaming compliant, zero entry fees, zero custody of spectator funds).

## Core Live Stream Features & Chat Commands
- **1v1 Battle & King of the Hill (`!battle <slot>`, `!continue`, `!cashout`)**: Viewers enter the Dual Wheel with their favorite slot. Each 1v1 victory awards $5 USD, up to 4 consecutive wins ($20 USD max cap).
- **Slot Requests Roulette (`!sr <slot>`)**: Automated live roulette wheel displaying `@username + Slot Name` on each slice and revealing the winning viewer's Kick Avatar, `@username`, and official `180x236` Slot Card.
- **8-Bracket Slot Tournament (`!tourney <slot>`)**: Single-elimination 8-player bracket with Bonus Buy (Multiplier) and 1-Click Spins modes.
- **Community Bonus Hunt (`!guess <amount>`)**: Live tracker for bonus opening sessions with ROI %, running average multiplier (`X`), required break-even `X`, and automated Guess The Final Balance settlement.

## Public Sections & OBS Studio Browser Sources
- [Main Community Hub & Stream Center](https://diggitybets.vip/): Live Kick stream embed, 1v1 Battle Arena, 8-Bracket Tournament, Bonus Hunt Tracker, Free House Games, and 4,889 Curated Slots Explorer.
- [1v1 Battle & KotH OBS Overlay](https://diggitybets.vip/overlay-battle/index.html?obs=1): Transparent `1920x1080` real-time arena overlay.
- [Dual Wheel OBS Overlay](https://diggitybets.vip/wheel-duo/index.html?obs=1): Synchronized `620x620` dual roulette for `!battle` and `!tourney`.
- [Slot Requests (!sr) OBS Overlay](https://diggitybets.vip/overlay-slotrequests/index.html?obs=1): Transparent `620x620` roulette and winner showcase card for `!sr <slot>`.
- [8-Bracket Tournament OBS Overlay](https://diggitybets.vip/overlay-tourney/index.html?obs=1): Transparent `1920x1080` live tournament bracket.
- [Community Bonus Hunt OBS Overlay](https://diggitybets.vip/overlay-bonushunt/index.html?obs=1): Transparent `1920x1080` live bonus hunt ticker.
- [Winner Celebration OBS Overlay](https://diggitybets.vip/overlay-celebration/index.html?obs=1): Transparent `1920x1080` dual-tier celebration (partial round win vs grand champion fanfare, falling coins, and spectator avatar).
